notes: Both compounds follow the part-of-speech line exactly: `village_potter` and `clay_vessel` get their head genus while the noun modifiers `village` and `clay` are correctly left unexposed, and `potter` correctly gets no agent-nominalization capability ("a potter is one who pots" fails the by-definition test). Definite plural object -> group witness, creation verb -> `Patient`, and simple present -> no status atom (unmarked habitual) are all right.
